facts.business: Innovative Ideals and Services (India) Limited operates in its existing line of business with a focus on serving customers and developing sustainable business opportunities.

auditor.name: M/s. Keyur Shah & Associates, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion on inventory valuation: inventories carried at Rs. 50.40 Lakhs stated solely at cost, not at lower of cost or net realizable value, departure from Accounting Standard under section 133 of Companies Act, 2013; impact not ascertainable due to insufficient audit evidence and lack of physical verification. Material uncertainty related to going concern due to huge losses, write-off of receivables Rs. 404.00 Lakhs, net worth erosion, loan account classified as NPA with no interest provision booked.
